items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: he plays with people like David Murray and all of these

ctx.x: Jang. J-A-N-G. And he goes between a love for his Chinese music and a love for Duke Ellington and modern jazz music and he plays with people like David Murray and all of these — and so we went to Beijing for some kind of — I don’t know how they got us over there, it was some kind of basic Beijing Jazz Festival, which was only attended by the very rich, like a one time event. There’s a lot of those in different parts of the world, where the aristocrats or the ruling people, they like jazz and they have enough…
